invitations_open_email_idx.name: invitations_open_email_idx
invitations_open_email_idx.where: "invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "invitations"."revoked_at" is null and "invitations"."email" is not null

invitations_open_phone_idx.name: invitations_open_phone_idx
invitations_open_phone_idx.where: "invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "invitations"."revoked_at" is null and "invitations"."phone" is not null

invitations_channel_target.name: invitations_channel_target
invitations_channel_target.value: ("invitations"."channel" = 'email' and "invitations"."email" is not null and "invitations"."phone" is null) or ("invitations"."channel" = 'sms' and "invitations"."phone" is not null and "invitations"."email" is null)

payments_has_stripe_reference.name: payments_has_stripe_reference
payments_has_stripe_reference.value: "payments"."stripe_payment_intent_id" is not null or "payments"."stripe_invoice_id" is not null

subscriptions_stripe_fields.name: subscriptions_stripe_fields
subscriptions_stripe_fields.value: ("subscriptions"."source" = 'stripe' and "subscriptions"."stripe_subscription_id" is not null and "subscriptions"."interval" is not null) or ("subscriptions"."source" = 'admin' and "subscriptions"."stripe_subscription_id" is null)

subscriptions_period_order.name: subscriptions_period_order
subscriptions_period_order.value: "subscriptions"."current_period_end" is null or "subscriptions"."current_period_start" is null or "subscriptions"."current_period_end" > "subscriptions"."current_period_start"

storage_objects_kind_fields.name: storage_objects_kind_fields
storage_objects_kind_fields.value: ("storage_objects"."kind" = 'folder' and "storage_objects"."size_bytes" = 0 and "storage_objects"."storage_key" is null) or ("storage_objects"."kind" = 'file' and "storage_objects"."storage_key" is not null)

upload_fees_paid_has_payment.name: upload_fees_paid_has_payment
upload_fees_paid_has_payment.value: "upload_fees"."paid_at" is null or "upload_fees"."payment_id" is not null

support_access_approved_fields.name: support_access_approved_fields
support_access_approved_fields.value: "support_access_grants"."status" <> 'approved' or ("support_access_grants"."decided_at" is not null and "support_access_grants"."expires_at" is not null)

support_access_max_24h.name: support_access_max_24h
support_access_max_24h.value: "support_access_grants"."expires_at" is null or "support_access_grants"."decided_at" is null or "support_access_grants"."expires_at" <= "support_access_grants"."decided_at" + interval '24 hours'
